title: Enforce replay memory budgets over event storage and oversized chunks
description:
## Finding

Per-pane replay advertises a bounded ring, but only byte payload lengths are charged. Resize events and structural allocations escape the budget, and the final retained event is exempt from eviction even when larger than the entire limit.

## Evidence

Baseline crates/thegn-host/src/replay.rs:111–143 charges push_bytes payload only; record_resize appends an Event without increasing bytes_used. evict at161–163 exits whenever events.len <=1. Event/deque capacity, Box allocation and keyframe storage are uncharged.
Standalone audit harness /tmp/thegn-audit/replay-probe/replay.rs proves 4096 resize events at one timestamp remain under a configured 1-byte budget, with bytes_used0 and at least98304 bytes of Event storage. Another test retains one1024-byte payload under an8-byte budget. Root reran both within the four-test audit reproduction suite. These assert defects, not remediation.

## Impact

Payload byte limits do not give an actual memory bound; high-rate resize/event streams and many panes can accumulate substantially more memory than promised. Duration eviction only limits age, not event density, and can be disabled. Oversized final chunks explicitly violate the cap.

## Acceptance

* Define and enforce a conservative hard bound covering retained payloads, event/deque/keyframe allocations, capacity retention and any snapshots introduced for fidelity.
* Add an independent event-count limit and coalesce redundant resize events where semantically valid.
* Split, refuse, or safely evict oversized chunks according to an explicit replay contract; no exempt final event.
* Bound aggregate recording resources across live panes, including configuration decreases and disabled recording.
* Tests include resize-only floods, tiny chunks, one oversized chunk, same timestamp, max_duration0, budget0/tiny/max, eviction/capacity shrink, and snapshot accounting. Assert peak live accounting, not only payload lengths.
* Preserve reconstruction semantics or report a deliberate fidelity boundary when eviction must drop parser/grid context.

## Dependencies

Related OOB accounting discipline <issue id="33c2014a-7d14-435c-bad1-aa2ebf17746a" href="https://linear.app/blakeashley/issue/THE-359/include-terminal-transport-buffers-in-the-out-of-band-memory-cap">THE-359</issue>, but this is a separate per-pane replay resource owner. <issue id="dfee0303-d7d1-4037-b89c-37adb785746a" href="https://linear.app/blakeashley/issue/THE-548/keep-filtered-corner-streams-from-retaining-replay-recordings-with">THE-548</issue> eliminates unused corner rings without fixing center replay bounds. Retained-state correctness and asynchronous search must consume this bounded storage contract.
